people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”
translations.bsb: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called his older son Esau and said to him, “My son.” “Here I am,” Esau replied.

translations.asv: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said unto him, My son. And he said unto him, Here am I.
